jobs.description: Global Payouts Introduction Introduction to Global Payouts API Callbacks Neema Global API v1.0 Authentication Account Balances Account format Account verification Available Countries Global Destinations Global PUSH TO CARD - card info Global Payouts Global Rates PayIns Schemas Global Payouts Introduction Introduction to Global Payouts API This lightweight REST (JSON) API is intended for sending payments to banks, cash pickup locations and digital wallets internationally. This fully automated API includes real time* updates for transaction statuses. This document will lay down the process of creating a payout, getting the status (via callbacks or on demand) and the various APIs and models that should be used in the process *Real time updates are supported for select destinations and sending methods Callbacks Signature verification code sample If a callback URL has been provided, transaction updates will be sent to the URL in real-time when changes in transaction status occur. In addition, transaction status can be queried through one of two means: via the returned id or a provided external_id. The body schema is StatusResponse. The request includes an Hmac SHA256 signature and corresponding headers so you can validate the authenticity of the request with the following headers: X-Neema-hmac - the Hmac signature X-Neema-nonce - the nonce used in the computation of the signature X-Neema-date - The timestamp in ISO format e.g '2000-01-01T00:00:00 The signature is a concatenation of the full url, nonce and date in UTF-8 encoding, signed with you API key using HmacSHA256 and finally encoded as base64. Neema Global API v1.0 Scroll down for code samples, example requests and responses. Select a language for code samples from the tabs above or the mobile navigation menu. Neema Global API Documentation Base URLs: please contact Neema support for details. Supports multiple values using repeated query parameters, e.g. ?transactionType=InternationalPayout&transactionType=PayIn. jobs.title: CoverageReach new markets with optimized global coverage
jobs.description: EVERY CORNER OF THE WORLD WITH A SINGLE INTEGRATION Keep up with user demand, even in the most hard to reach markets. 120+ Countries 90+ Currencies Millions of daily transactions Explore Our Coverage Select the destination country All Africa America APAC Europe Middle East Albania Andorra Argentina Armenia Australia Austria Azerbaijan Bangladesh Belgium Bolivia Brazil Bulgaria Burkina Faso Canada China Colombia Croatia Cyprus Czechia Democratic Republic of the Congo Denmark Ecuador England Estonia Ethiopia Finland France Georgia Germany Ghana Greece Hong Kong Hungary Iceland India Indonesia Ireland Israel Italy Ivory Coast Kazakhstan Kenya Latvia Liechtenstein Lithuania Luxembourg Malawi Malta Mexico Moldova Monaco Morocco Nepal Netherlands Nigeria Norway Peru Philippines Poland Portugal Romania Rwanda San Marino Senegal Singapore Slovakia Slovenia South Africa Spain Sri Lanka Sweden Switzerland Tanzania Thailand Turkey Uganda Ukraine United Arab Emirates United States Uzbekistan Vietnam Zambia Your customer transfers toUnited States Via Bank account Local Expertise, Global Reach Access even the toughest destinations with confidence. From mobile wallets and cards to cash pickups and local banks, we support the payment methods your customers trust most. Frequently Asked Questions All The Coverage Send Money The API Security I want to add a new corridor. Where do I find if Neema offers it and what are the conditions? To add more corridors, contact your Account Manager. For more information about potential destinations, visit the Coverage page. What payout methods are available with Neema? Neema offers payouts to bank accounts, mobile wallets, cash pickups, and cards. Does Neema also support payins, or just payouts? Yes, in selected markets Neema offers a complete cross-border solution with both payins and payouts, including local account issuance and unified API access. Does Neema support payins to Israel? Yes. Neema supports payins within Israel through a simple and fast API integration that connects directly to our payouts system. Funds can be sent from any Israeli bank account. How can you promise a high success rate for exotic locations? Neema’s Dynamic Routing® technology evaluates every transaction in real-time, checking availability, cost, risk, and client preferences, to ensure it takes the best possible route. This intelligent routing not only makes payouts to exotic locations more reliable, but also builds trust and drives higher volumes for our clients. Enter a new standard of cross border payments Share your details and one of our experts will get back to you!

jobs.description: SECURITY YOU CAN RELY ON At Neema, security is built into every layer of our platform. From infrastructure to transactions, we combine advanced technology and constant monitoring to keep your business and users safe. AI-Driven Transaction Monitoring Real-time intelligence that keeps payments secure. Cloud-First Defense Security that scales globally and adapts instantly. Human + Machine Oversight Intelligent automation with the assurance of human expertise. Built For Trust At Neema, your business security is at the heart of everything we do. We’ve engineered our systems with cutting-edge technology, industry certifications, and continuous monitoring to ensure that every transaction is safe, fast, and flawless. We take pride in our transparent practices and maintain compliance with the highest global standards. Security in Every Step Regulated & Compliant Neema adheres to strict regulatory standards and maintains full compliance with national and international financial and data protection frameworks Secure Development Practices Our platform is built following secure coding standards, and our developers receive ongoing training to stay ahead of evolving threats. Independent Security Testing External experts conduct regular penetration tests to ensure our systems remain resilient against emerging risks. Proactive Protection We stop attempted scams through smart detection and early warning triggers, helping you maintain trust and avoid user complaints. Fully Licensed and Regulated We operate under the strict supervision of leading regulatory authorities in Israel and international standards for data protection. Our licenses and certifications show our commitment to providing secure, transparent, and trustworthy financial services.
